reviews.title: Scammy Subscription
reviews.text:
Manage subscription takes you to their legal notice section of a document on their site. Once you signup for the 3 day “trial” you can not unsubscribe from within the application. Should be removed from the App Store as they use deceptive tactics against consumers. Avoid at all costs!

And when you look at this and understand this a vibe coded app it makes sense.

reviews.title: Escape the payment
reviews.text: All you have to do to escape the subscription fee is to click the little x in the top left corner. But then many features are locked, such as the most needed ones like tap. If I only need to pay once for the TE tuner app and have everything unlocked to me across all devices, I’d rather not download this one.

reviews.title: No one in there would pay these rates!
reviews.text: $3.99 per week or $49.99 per year!!!  This it literally one of the most overpriced things I’ve ever seen.

reviews.title: Subscriptions for metronomes…
reviews.text: It seems like paying a subscription for a metronome is way more common than it should be… but $3.99 a week for a metronome is absolute insanity. It seems like a decent metronome, but that is $200 a year for a metronome.

reviews.title: Battery drainer & spyware
reviews.text: This app was reported for using around 30% of my battery (beefy iPhone 16 Pro battery) in the background everyday that it was open on the background, regardless of it I’d used it recently or not. No other app in my phone uses more than 1% in background, ever, even though I leave them open. Makes me wonder what they’re doing using so much battery?
